title: [AUG-136] In-app GPU engine switch and CUDA install in Settings
why_we_need_this: The CPU/CUDA engine is chosen only in the Windows installer (AUG-130). In dev mode and for users who picked CPU, transcription runs on CPU even on a machine with an NVIDIA GPU (RTX 4060 here), diagnostics are all green, and Settings only shows a read-only engine status. Users cannot switch or install the GPU engine without reinstalling.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Server detects an NVIDIA GPU (nvidia-smi) on Windows x64 and exposes it via /api/health without breaking existing fields.
2. Settings → Transcription has a CPU / GPU (NVIDIA) selector; GPU option is shown only when an NVIDIA GPU is detected.
3. Selecting GPU when CUDA binaries are missing starts the cudaDownloader (~457 MB) with visible progress; transcription stays on CPU until it finishes.
4. The choice persists across restarts (packaged and dev) and applies without reinstall; WHISPER_GPU_ENGINE env still wins if set explicitly.
5. When a GPU is detected but the engine is CPU, diagnostics show a yellow plain-language hint pointing to the switch (no backend names/DLLs in UI).
6. Works on Windows; macOS behaviour unchanged (Metal, no selector).
7. Unit tests cover engine resolution and persistence; project-context (whisper-setup, preferences) updated.
